caption: The apple in here makes it so unique and delicious and adds just a hint of sweetness. 1 butternut squash 2 apples 1 large sweet onion 1 head of garlic 2-3 carrots Roast together for 45 minutes at 375. Take apple out after 30. Add to stock pot and add 2-3 cups of bone broth, salt and pepper. Simmer for 15 minutes. Blend with immersion blender. Top with cream and maple syrup for a very lovely little addition! #lunchideas #homecooking #stayathomemom
